title: 第2299章 拘灵城第2298章 万釜齐气法
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【因为对你越加敬佩，所以对你实力也更加认可，晨宽不认为自己的这位至亲至信能够赢得了你，但他也同时担心你会直接杀死古目。
你对自己人确实很好，可对待外人，若非自己这些人有晨曦这个因素在，晨宽是知道你的果决与残忍的，必是杀之而后快……晨宽的情绪变化很丰富，而你也全都感受到了，能够猜测到他的想法。但你还是特意卖了卖关子，直到晨宽的情绪紧张到一个极点之后，这才说出了古目的结局。
那一刻，晨宽整个人的脸色都没法再控制，显而易见的松弛了下来。这一刻，他对晨媛告诉你有关伪道元身傀的事情再无芥蒂，态度已然两极反转。
只是接下来，让晨宽没有想到的是，你直接便将古目从无量乾坤中放了出来，带到了他的面前……】
【你本来是打算与晨宽提前说，让他劝说古目之类的话。可在全程感受晨宽的情绪变化后，你鬼使神差的改变了主意，觉得不说，最后所能得到的结果，或许会更好。
尽管这么做之后很快，你便有了一丝悔意，但也只是一瞬，你又坚定了自己的选择。】
【你就这样静静的等待，继续思考着当初施展大志魔封时的场景，寻找自己在整个过程中的错漏。而也是如此过去了半日时间，晨宽带着古目出来了。
古目对待你的态度怎么样，这一点从你能够感受到她更清晰的情绪变化便可知晓。也只有仇恨到极致仇恨，或是亲近与极致亲近你的人，才能有情绪的明显变化。
古目的样子不像是仇恨，那么只有一种可能，她从原本对待你不善的态度，变为了友善。
而果然，之后与古目的接触，她对待你的大多数问题都有问必答，且情绪并无诡辩的波动，让你觉得可以拿来参考一二。】
【“鬼使神差？”不存在的，跳出自己性子的选择出现，你已然可以确定这便是自己身上的某个能力又不经意间发挥。或许是极致魅力天赋的触动，又或者是其他……】
【古目，这位的身份说来你都有些诧异，她竟然就是晨宽师父的亲奶奶，也是由晨宽师尊的爷爷亲手将之炼成的伪道元身傀。符合晨宽所说的至亲至信，也是他这一脉师承的穿透。
在晨宽的身上，古目得知了自己丈夫最后的下场，以及其子孙的凄惨日子……不过若非是得曦照云府的收留，古目的孙子会过得更惨就是。
从这一点来看，古目清楚曦照云府对自己是有恩情的，而她也认可晨宽所学，将之当做了自己人。这一次的配合，便是古目从晨宽那里了解到了你的为人，结合她在见到你后本想要直接杀死她的举动，她对你也没那么大的怨恨。
毕竟就如晨宽所说，对待自己人这一块，你是极为难得的温和。只要不被你知晓古目有明显的反心，在她与晨宽相认之时，她就真正脱离了危险，不用担心被你拉出去当成材料拆了。但同时，对于这样一个性格的你，古目觉得也很有依附的必要。这既是为了更大可能保住自己的性命，也是她想真的尝试融合你阵营的自觉。
仇恨这种东西，从古至今都是不弱于爱的强大力量。而真正的爱难寻，仇恨却容易出现。这一刻，古目便已经被那明明已经过去许久的仇恨唤醒，难以再继续麻痹自己。因为从晨宽这里她已经得知，无论当初与自己恩爱无比的道侣，亦或是她珍爱的儿子女儿，其下场都被那人所害。
且死状都并不如何美好，大多是不是被折磨致死，就是阴谋算计痛不欲生。这种痛苦，就算是到了晨宽的师父，也就古目的孙子辈，依旧凄惨。】
【只是，能够在得到曦照云府的看中，被晨曦亲自收留的情况下都没法除去的仇人。古目当初所得罪的人身份与实力也并不简单，是一个在上庭天比较曦照云府还要强大几分的势力。
这势力身居“拘灵城”，而以此城的规矩，能入得了座便都是自己人，是一个坚固无比的巨大联盟型大势力。时至今日，也几乎可以算得上是拘灵城在整个历史上最为强势的时刻，拥有着两位已经完成三气平衡的强大修士。
诚然，在晨宽口中其中一位是完全依靠的外物，实力算得上是三气平衡修士中的垫底，曾被晨曦亲手打成重伤，击退过一次。而晨曦本身的实力，在同境也也只能算是勉勉强强，这便也可见一般。
但不管怎么说，这也不是现在的古目能够对付得了的。因为像是拘灵城这样的势力，在上庭天也都能算得上是二流势力，有成为几个顶级势力堂下客的机会。只要成为了大势力的走狗，再想要轻易除去，此间难度便也大得多。】
【古目非常清楚，自己想要对付这样的势力，哪怕是有朝一日参修出了伪道道根，也很难报的了仇。这让古目感觉很难受，也痛恨自己为什么当初不选择彻底了解敌人。又为何在唾手可得机缘时一时心软，不去触碰……
但事已至此，若还想要报仇，古目也只能将复仇的希望放在其他人的身上。
当日之事，古目不曾见你出手，只是被墨骨与蚌灵联合收服，所以被人以多打少，古目还颇有不服。可听晨宽说，你的实力一点都不差，虽说是出自罪界，却是不世出的强大修士，亲自参与并粉碎了上庭天的圣战，以获得了难得的和平。
尤其是晨宽从晨媛口中，而晨媛从晨曦那里得知，你当初只身与神武交手的壮举。】
【神武不是什么简单的人物，所以这让古目在得到这个消息时甚至一时无法相信这会是真的。毕竟哪怕同为完成了三气平衡的至圣神君，可人与人之间差距可以比人与狗的差距还要大。
神武活的很久，能成为尊神点名的打手，他在古目那时就已经闯下了不小的战绩。如这般实力的人，就算一场大战杀死一两位同境的至圣神君，这消息也都能为人理解。】
content_en:
[Because I admire you more and more, I also recognize your strength more. Chen Kuan does not think that his closest relative can win you, but he is also worried that you will kill Gu Mu directly.
You are indeed very kind to your own people, but when it comes to treating outsiders, if Chen Xi hadn't been there for you, Chen Kuan would have known how decisive and cruel you were, and would have killed you quickly... Chen Kuan's emotions changed a lot, and you felt them all, and could guess his thoughts. But you still went out of your way to sell it off, and it wasn't until Chen Kuan's emotions reached an extreme point that you told Gu Mu's ending.
At that moment, Chen Kuan could no longer control his expression, and he obviously relaxed. At this moment, he no longer has any grudge against Chen Yuan telling you about the fake Dao Yuan body puppet, and his attitude has completely reversed.
But what Chen Kuan didn’t expect was that you directly released Gu Mu from the Infinite Universe and brought him in front of him...]
[You originally planned to talk to Chen Kuan in advance and let him persuade Gu Mu. But after feeling Chen Kuan's emotional changes throughout the whole process, you accidentally changed your mind and felt that if you didn't tell him, the final result might be better.
Although you felt a trace of regret soon after doing this, it was only for a moment that you became firm in your choice. 】
[You just wait quietly like this, continuing to think about the scene when you used the Demonic Seal of Ambition, looking for your mistakes in the whole process. And half a day passed like this, and Chen Kuan came out with Gu Mu.
How Gumu treats you can be known by the way you can feel her clearer emotional changes. Only those who hate you to the point of extreme hatred, or are close to or extremely close to you, can you experience significant changes in your mood.
Gu Mu doesn't look like she is filled with hatred, so there is only one possibility. She has changed her attitude towards you from being unkind to being friendly.
And sure enough, after contacting Gu Mu later, she answered most of your questions without any sophistical fluctuations in her mood, which made you feel that she could use it as a reference. 】
["A strange mistake?" There is no such thing as a choice outside of your own temperament. You can already be sure that this is a certain ability in you that you have inadvertently exerted. Maybe it’s the touch of the ultimate charm talent, or something else...]
[Gumu, you are a little surprised by the identity of this person. She is actually Master Chen Kuan’s grandmother, and she is also a pseudo-Daoyuan body puppet made by Master Chen Kuan’s grandfather. It is in line with what Chen Kuan said about the closest relatives and friends, and it is also the penetration of his lineage of teachers.
From Chen Kuan, Gu Mu learned about his husband's final fate and the miserable life of his descendants... However, if it had not been for De Xi Zhaoyun Mansion to take him in, Gu Mu's grandson would have lived an even worse life.
From this point of view, Gu Mu knew that Xi Zhaoyun Mansion was kind to her, and she also recognized what Chen Kuan had learned and regarded him as one of her own. The cooperation this time is that Gu Mu learned about you from Chen Kuan. Combined with her intention to kill her directly after seeing you, she doesn't have that much resentment towards you.
After all, as Chen Kuan said, you are extremely gentle when dealing with your own people. As long as you don't know that Gu Mu has any obvious reluctance, when she recognizes Chen Kuan, she will truly be out of danger, and you don't have to worry about being pulled out and used as material. But at the same time, Gu Mu feels that it is necessary to be attached to you with such a character. This is not only to have a greater chance of saving her own life, but also because she really wants to try to integrate with your camp.
Hatred has been a powerful force that is not weaker than love since ancient times. While true love is hard to find, hatred is easy to appear. At this moment, Gu Mu was awakened by the hatred that had obviously passed for a long time, and it was difficult to continue to paralyze himself. Because she had already learned from Chen Kuan that no matter the Taoist companion with whom she was extremely affectionate, or her cherished son or daughter, they all ended up being harmed by that person.
And the conditions of death are not very good. Most of them are either tortured to death, or they are in pain due to conspiracy and conspiracy. This kind of pain is still miserable even for Chen Kuan's master and Gu Mu's grandchildren. 】
[It’s just that he is an enemy who can’t get rid of even if he gets the favor of Xi Zhaoyun Mansion and is taken in by Chen Xi himself. The identity and strength of the person Gu Mu had offended at the beginning was not simple. He was a force that was somewhat more powerful in Shangtingtian than Xi Zhaoyun Mansion.
This force is located in the "Juling City", and according to the rules of this city, everyone who can get in is one of its own. It is an extremely strong and huge alliance-type force. To this day, it can almost be regarded as the most powerful moment in the entire history of Juling City, with two powerful monks who have completed the balance of the three qi.
It is true that in Chen Kuan's mouth, one of them is a foreign object that he can completely rely on. His strength can be regarded as the lowest among the three Qi balance monks. He was seriously injured by Chen Xi himself and was repelled once. And Chen Xi's own strength can only be regarded as barely adequate in the same realm, which shows that it is average.
But no matter what, this is not something that Gu Mu can deal with now. Because a force like Juling City can be considered a second-rate force in Shangtingtian, it has the opportunity to become a guest of several top forces. Once you become a lackey of a big force, it will be much more difficult to get rid of it easily. 】
[Gumu is very clear that if he wants to deal with such a force, even if he one day practices the false Taoist roots, it will be difficult to avenge him. This made Gumu feel very uncomfortable, and he also hated himself for not choosing to fully understand the enemy in the first place. And why do you feel soft-hearted and don't touch the opportunity when you have it at your fingertips...
But the matter has come to this, if he still wants revenge, Gu Mu can only place his hope of revenge on others.
What happened that day, Gu Mu never saw you take action, but was subdued by Mo Gu and Clam Ling. Therefore, Gu Mu was still quite dissatisfied with being beaten by more people than by others. But Chen Kuan said that your strength is not bad at all. Although you come from the world of sin, you are an unparalleled powerful monk. You personally participated in and crushed the holy war in Shangtingtian, and gained a rare peace.
Especially Chen Kuan learned from Chen Yuan, and Chen Yuan learned from Chen Xi about your feat of fighting against Shenwu alone. 】
[Shenwu is not a simple character, so when Gumu got the news, he couldn't even believe that it was true. After all, even if they are both the Holy Lords who have completed the balance of the three qi, the gap between people can be greater than the gap between people and dogs.
Shenwu lived a long time and could become a thug named by the gods. He had already achieved considerable success in Gumu. For a person with such strength, even if one or two of the Holy Lords of the same realm were killed in a battle, the news would still be understandable. 】
